pipeline.modality: Anti-CD40L IgG1 monoclonal antibody (Fc-modified to avoid platelet activation)
pipeline.license_origin: Eledon internal (acquired via Anelixis Therapeutics, Sept 2020)

indications.indication: Prevention of allograft rejection in de novo kidney transplantation
indications.trial_name: BESTOW (Phase 2) and Phase 1b kidney transplant studies
indications.trial_design: BESTOW: multi-center, two-arm, head-to-head superiority Phase 2 vs tacrolimus, ~120 participants; primary endpoint eGFR at 12 months. Phase 1b open-label, up to 36 patients, tegoprubart-based regimen replacing tacrolimus
indications.trial_status: BESTOW completed (last patient dosed Sept 4, 2025; topline reported Nov 6, 2025 — non-inferior on efficacy composite, favorable safety vs tacrolimus). Long-term extension enrolling by invitation. Phase 1b recruiting. Phase 3 planning underway in 2026 pending FDA guidance.

indications.indication: Xenotransplantation (genetically modified pig kidney/heart) — collaboration with eGenesis
indications.trial_name: eGenesis xenotransplant procedures using tegoprubart-based immunosuppression
indications.trial_design: Compassionate use / early clinical xenotransplantation procedures (4 to date: 3 pig kidneys, 1 pig heart) under FDA expanded access / IND
indications.trial_status: Active — 4 procedures conducted; 2 kidney recipients alive (1 maintains pig kidney function)

indications.indication: Islet cell transplantation for Type 1 diabetes (investigator-initiated)
indications.trial_name: University of Chicago investigator-initiated islet transplantation
indications.trial_design: Investigator-initiated open-label study assessing CNI-free immunosuppression with tegoprubart in T1D patients undergoing ICT
indications.trial_status: Recruiting — as of Nov 2025, 8 patients underwent ICT with tegoprubart; first 6 reported insulin independence
indications.lead_sponsor: University of Chicago (Eledon supplies drug only — investigator-initiated)
